data.name: Swashbuckler Initiative
data.description: At 3rd level, as long as the swashbuckler has at least 1 panache point, she gains the following benefits. First, she gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks. Furthermore, if she has the Quick Draw feat, her hands are free and unrestrained, and she has any light or one-handed piercing weapon that is not hidden, she can draw that weapon as part of the initiative check.
